data.gender_notes: Dishu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: God of abundance, giver of prosperity
data.long_meaning: Dishu is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dhishana', which means 'God of abundance'. It is a name given to the deity who is believed to be the giver of prosperity and abundance in life. The name is also associated with the fertility of the earth and the growth of crops. The name Dishu carries the meaning “God of abundance, giver of prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Dishu usually hope their child will grow to embody god of abundance, giver of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Dishu is a spiritual name that represents the abundance and prosperity that comes from the divine. It is a reminder of the blessings that come from the universe and the importance of being grateful for them.
data.etymology: Dishu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of abundance, giver of prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dishu total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
